## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `572fd84958050b4529c3f4b2fa831c94197db00c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx, packages/components/src/__tests__/page-template-slots-12476.test.tsx, packages/types/src/__tests__/layout-default-jsdoc-7361.test.ts + .changeset/12476-page-template-slots.md (prose face, judged under ②), packages/components/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml (the packages/components importer), packages/components/vite.config.ts, scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs with .github/workflows/spec-range-floors.yml and the root changeset:publish script, .changeset/23610-record-page-seed-default.md, packages/types/src/layout.ts, packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts, packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts, packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx, packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.tsx, packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts; @objectstack/spec at 18.0.0-next.3 (packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts, the semantic migration 18.page-template-closed-region-unplaced-refused, the conversion page-template-full-width-to-default) and page.zod.ts at 18.0.0-next.1 and 18.0.0-next.2 for the floor

Read against the card #12476 (body and all six comments), the ruling objectstack#23610 comment 6190536588 (items 2 and 5), the PR body, the net diff from merge-base `d2b21a1225`, and the 36 check-runs on this head.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Slotted templates draw only what they place: RIGHT.** On `default`, `header-sidebar-main` and `three-column`, a region outside `PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS[template]` is no longer stacked under `main`. It is drawn nowhere, and the `data-page-refusal="unplaced-region"` panel in the main column names the region and the slots. The accept set now equals the spec's `checkPageRegionPlacement` for `kind: 'full'` pages: the same slot table is imported, and names match case-insensitively on both sides. This is what ruling items 2 and 5 bind, and the card's "the renderer keeps no fallback for a shape the spec refuses". A visible refusal is better than a silent drop: the semantic migration at next.3 serves a stored row with an unplaced region "unchanged", so real rows reach this branch.
- **`dashboard` keeps its open grid: RIGHT.** `getRemainingRegions(regions, PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS.dashboard)` excludes `header` and `footer` exactly as the old literal did, so this template's accept set is unchanged. A control test pins it.
- **`full-width` leaves `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY`, and `FullWidthTemplate` becomes `DefaultTemplate`: RIGHT.** Both names pointed to one component. The ruling allows no alias window. The spec enum refuses `full-width`, and the data-at-rest conversion `page-template-full-width-to-default` rewrites a stored row to `default` on read, so a served row keeps its layout. Neither name was exported, because the module's only export is `PageRenderer`, so the rename does not change the public surface.
- **An unregistered template draws `UnregisteredTemplateRefusal` instead of the pageType layout: RIGHT.** The spec enum refuses every other name at the parse. The own-property lookup also fixes a latent crash at the merge-base: there, `template: 'constructor'` resolved the inherited `Object` constructor as a layout component. A test now pins that case.
- **The registry is a Record keyed by the spec's `PageTemplate`: RIGHT.** A missing or extra key is a type error, so the renderer's set cannot drift from the spec without failing to compile. Type Check is green on this head.
- **The pageType dispatch (no `template`) still stacks: RIGHT for this claim, with a residual.** The claim scoped this path out, and the dev measured real producers on it: PageView and PagePreview spread raw rows, and Studio's addRegion writes `region_N`. The renderer is still more permissive here than the spec, whose check judges an absent template as `default`. That residual is carried to ③.
- **Residual: one shape is refused beyond the spec, not a defect.** The spec does not judge region names on a `kind: 'slotted'` page. If such a raw row with a region its template does not place reached `PageRenderer`, the renderer would now refuse it. No producer was found. Slotted pages carry `regions: []` and render through `buildDefaultPageSchema` (RecordDetailView, PagePreview), and the served approval page has the same shape.
- **In-repo producers are unaffected: RIGHT, as the PR body says.** `buildDefaultPageSchema` is the only code that sets `template`. It always writes `default`, with `main` and an optional `aside`.
- **New DOM hook `data-page-refusal`, with English refusal text and no i18n key: RIGHT.** It follows the html tier's compile-error panel, the existing author-facing refusal on this page. No export, prop, type or language-pack key changes.
- **WRONG: the `@objectstack/spec` floor of `@object-ui/components`.** The head adds a runtime import of `PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` and evaluates it at module scope (`TEMPLATE_NAMES`). That symbol is absent from page.zod.ts at the `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.1` tag and present from next.2. The package still declares `"@objectstack/spec": "^18.0.0-next.1"`.
  - The build keeps spec external and inlines the package into one bundle. Under a spec at the declared floor, the whole of `@object-ui/components` therefore fails to load, not just the page renderer.
  - objectui's floor rule (objectui#5793, `scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs`) reports this as `floor-too-low`. Its blocking copy runs inside `pnpm changeset:publish`, so landing this head cancels the next release of the fixed group.
  - The gate is deliberately not a pull-request job, which is why every check on this head is green.
  - The package's other runtime spec imports (`resolveI18nLabel`, `isFileIdToken`) exist at next.1, so this head is what introduces the violation.
  - Precedent: PR #12648 (objectui#12626) raised `@object-ui/types` to `^18.0.0-next.2` in the same PR, for the same reason (`checkPageRegionPlacement`).
  - The seat's card note recorded this floor and left it unchanged. I reverse that judgment.

### ② Semver level

- **`'@object-ui/components': minor`: RIGHT.** The narrowing is breaking. objectui's fixed group never declares `major` (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`), so a breaking change is a `minor` that states its breaking semantics in the body, and this body does: what used to stack, what draws now, that `full-width` no longer resolves, and what is unchanged. No other package publishes from this diff, because the `@object-ui/types` change is a test file.
- **The Clause-② declaration `no (narrowing)`, on the PR body and the changeset: RIGHT.** No published schema or type changes. `PageNodeSchema.template` is already `SpecPage['template']`, which is closed at next.3, `regions[].name` stays `string`, and nothing under `packages/types/src` moves. The narrowing is in what a published component draws, and that face is what this record covers.
- **The changeset prose: RIGHT at this head.** I checked each sentence against the diff and the spec at next.3, and each is true. It owes one sentence once the floor moves: that `@object-ui/components` now needs `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.2 or later. Recommended, not required: spell out the renames (`full-width` → `default`; `left_sidebar` → `sidebar`, `right_sidebar` → `aside`, `content` → `main`).
- **WRONG: a pending changeset this head makes false.** `.changeset/23610-record-page-seed-default.md` is still pending (pre mode has not consumed it), so it ships in the same release. It says "The renderer maps `default` and `full-width` to the same `FullWidthTemplate`" and "The renderer still recognises `full-width`, so pages already stored with it keep rendering". This head makes both false, so the `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/types` changelog entries would contradict the `@object-ui/components` entry in the same release. The Changeset Claim Re-read gate does not catch it: its went-false reading looks for a pending body that names a file this change touches, and this body names symbols, not `page.tsx`.
- **Check-runs on this head: none failed.** Of 36, 33 succeeded and 3 were skipped (the two coverage jobs and dependabot).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag, the ruling comment was unreadable (403): answered.** I read 6190536588. Item 2 is the closed template set, the declared slots, the refusal at validate and at save, and `full-width` retiring with no alias window. Item 5 names this card: it "retires the stack-the-rest branch for authored pages". Nothing in the ruling keeps a fallback.
- **Dev flag, H2 is partly falsified (stored rows with an unplaced region are not migrated): confirmed.** The semantic migration's own text says such a row "is served unchanged and renders as before". That is why the refusal in open question 1 is right.
- **Dev flag, the live reading was not measured: accepted.** The pins render through `SchemaRenderer` and the component registry, and Build & E2E is green, so no contract gap is left open.
- **Dev flag, gates were hand-derived and no CI was running yet: superseded.** CI on this head is green.
- **Open question 1, a visible refusal (A): right.** B (draw nothing) would silently hide live content that the migration leaves in place. C (stack) is the mis-layout the ruling retires.
- **Open question 2, a refusal for an unregistered template (A): right.** The spec refuses the name at the parse. The pageType layout would draw a different layout from the one named.
- **Open question 3, the template-less path still stacks: escalated.** A is right for this PR. What remains of "authored pages", and of the card's "keeps no fallback", is on the follow-up the seat records as objectui#12902 (comment 6235773759); I did not read that card. `Fixes #12476` closes the card with that remainder still open, so the ACCEPT should name it.
- **Open question 4, the upstream migration sentence "renders as before" becomes false: escalated to objectstack.** Its owner is objectstack's migration text. The seat's record says it files that card with the ACCEPT. It is owed at landing and does not block this head.
- **Out-of-scope finding, class c (Studio's addRegion writes `region_N`): escalated with open question 3 to objectui#12902.** After this head, Studio's preview of a `template: 'default'` draft shows the refusal for the region "Add region" just wrote. The renderer now agrees with the save door; the button is the defect.
- **Out-of-scope finding, class b: same as open question 4.**
- **Reviewer-raised, non-blocking: stale prose naming the old behaviour.**
  - `FullWidthTemplate` is still named in the comment above `template: 'default'` in `buildDefaultPageSchema`.
  - It is also named in the `PageNodeSchema.template` docblock in `packages/types/src/layout.ts`. Row 7 of the moved pin guards that docblock: the pin moved and its prose did not.
  - The `layout.zod.ts` comment still says the refusal names "the region the renderer stacks under `main`".
  - Fix these with this round, or card them.

**To pass on the next head:**
1. Raise `@objectstack/spec` in `packages/components/package.json` to `^18.0.0-next.2`, and change the matching `specifier` of the `packages/components` importer in `pnpm-lock.yaml`. The alternative is to drop the runtime import.
2. Correct the two sentences in `.changeset/23610-record-page-seed-default.md` that this head makes false, or have this PR's changeset say it supersedes them. Add the floor sentence to this PR's changeset.

The residuals above do not block. A new head needs a new record.
